business_problem: Geely needed a unified cloud and data foundation for intelligent manufacturing, R&D collaboration, and AI-driven business innovation as the company accelerated new-energy, software-defined, and cloud-native transformation across many global business units.
solution_summary: Geely and Baidu AI Cloud built a '1+6+N' hybrid-cloud platform that combines public cloud, Baidu private cloud, and a shared capability stack for manufacturing and digital operations. The '1' is the hybrid cloud itself, while the six core capabilities cover cloud infrastructure, cloud architecture, security operations, DevOps, business middle-platform services, and data services. This lets Geely centralize group-level cloud infrastructure, push existing business systems to the cloud, bring data into lakes for intelligent use, and build AI platforms that support innovation across vehicle networking, intelligent driving, marketing, and R&D. The platform also serves as the digital brain for factories and a collaboration base for global engineering, supplier coordination, and self-service infrastructure use across many business departments.

solution_components.name: BCC
solution_components.role: Provides the cloud compute layer used in Geely's group-wide hybrid-cloud platform.

solution_components.name: Hybrid Cloud Storage
solution_components.role: Supports the shared storage layer for data lakes, manufacturing visibility, and business-cloud workloads.

solution_components.name: IoT Core Suite
solution_components.role: Connects manufacturing and operational data into the hybrid-cloud platform for intelligent use.

data_flow: Manufacturing, R&D, supplier, and business-system data flows into the hybrid-cloud environment, where shared cloud, security, DevOps, and data-service capabilities support analytics, AI models, and collaboration across Geely's global operations and factory systems.
business_outcome: Geely reduced cloud operating costs, improved resource utilization, enabled global engineering collaboration, and established a cloud-and-data base for intelligent manufacturing and new automotive AI scenarios.
metrics: Management and operations costs fell more than 30%.
More than 20,000 R&D staff can collaborate globally.
More than 1,000 suppliers participate in manufacturing collaboration.
